corpus.content: Alex holds a master's degree in Computer Science from IISc Bangalore.
Alex has 8 years of professional software development experience.
The development machine is a Windows 11 workstation with 8 GB RAM and no dedicated GPU.
Prefers pytest over unittest for Python test suites.
Prefers explicit dependency injection over global singleton state.
Avoids using external cloud APIs when local offline models suffice.
Master Rust systems programming by Q3 2026.
Publish E.D.I.T.H. Brain Core as an open source MIT library.
Expert level proficiency in Python, FastAPI, and asynchronous programming.
Intermediate competence in Docker containerization and CI/CD pipelines.
Proficient in relational database schema design, index optimization, and SQL transactions.
E.D.I.T.H. Brain Core is currently located in directory D:/edith-brain-core.
The storage engine uses SQLite WAL mode with busy_timeout set to 5000 milliseconds.
Rejected Chroma and Milvus vector databases to avoid heavy JVM and native dependencies.
Adopted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with k=60 to merge BM25 and vector scores.
